eps.d: When the scatterbrained but prepetually enthusiastic inventor Doc moves into an old workshop with his faithful dog Sprocket, we discover that he is not alone and there are a race of strange creatures known as Fraggles living in a cave that connects to the workshop through vents. Meanwhile, Gobo's Uncle Traveling Matt is about to start his great adventure into outer space.
Wembley agrees with everyone, including the Gorgs, who decide he makes a great loyal subject.
Doc's effort to improve the plumbing in his workshop makes waves throughout the World of the Fraggles, Red has a one Fraggle swimming extravaganza.

eps.t: You Can't Do That Without a Hat
eps.d: Boober is really brave until he loses his lucky hat.
Wishy-washy Wembley's indecisiveness gets him into a world of trouble when it comes time to choose the job he is going to do.
Mokey tries to stand up for the Doozers who's elaborate constructions are regularly torn apart and eaten by the Fraggles.
Everyone loves Mokey, so Red decides to be just like her.
Wembley accidentally finds the legendary Terrible Tunnel.

eps.t: The Lost Treasure of the Fraggles
eps.d: Wembley and Red discover a old treasure map and go in search of the Ancient Treasure of the Fraggles. Meanwhile, Sprocket goes roller skating.
Gobo gets trapped in Outer Space when Doc boards up the hole in the wall.

eps.t: Catch the Tail by the Tiger
eps.d: It's been two weeks since Traveling Matt's last postcard, so Gobo decides to go into Outer Space to look for him.
The Oldest Fraggle introduces his fellow Fraggles to the dangerous ritual of choosing a ruling Fraggle. Uncle Matt meets the string people in his travels.
Doc finds a old chandelier and builds a combination alarm, smoke detector and lighting unit, Wembley becomes infatuated with a new friend.
Red challenges Gobo's leadership.
Boober is sick of everyone not respecting his feelings.
Gobo is the Moon-Greeter for this month's Festival of the Fraggle Moon, when Junior Gorg steals the Moon!
Boober's birthday is interrupted by a disaster (and didn't he just know this was going to happen?!).
The Fraggles meet the band of traveling musicians known as The Minstrels, led by the mysterious and wise Cantus. Everyone must find their own song, but Red is having a lot of trouble with hers.
The Trash Heap decides to teach the Fraggles, Doozers and Gorgs a lesson by magically making all the radishes in the Gorg's garden disappear.
Fraggle Rock is under attack from two sides when Sprocket tries to smash his way in, and Junior Gorg tries to pulverize it.
Gobo thinks he's lost his nerve and decides not to be an explorer anymore.
Nobody thinks Mokey is good at practical things, so she tries to deal with Junior Gorg's Fraggle trap on her own.
Wembley must choose between entering Red's splash-a-thon and accompanying Gobo on a scary journey.
Doc invents a diet drink, the Fraggles have a strange dream that convinces them that Mokey is their new prophet; causing Mokey to become the new Trash Heap that dispenses wisdom.
When a giant egg falls into Fraggle Pond, Wembley takes it upon himself to take care of the baby 'tree creature'. Doc works to improve his memory while forgetting something very important.
Boober's had enough of the noise of Fraggle Rock, so he moves to the Caves of Boredom.

eps.t: The Trash Heap Dosen't Live Here Anymore
eps.d: Ma Gorg wants a gazebo, so Junior has to get rid of the Trash Heap. Wembley and Boober have to figure out how to save her by themselves.
Red is jealous of Gobo, until she discovers a sea monster in Fraggle Rock.
Gobo's Uncle Matt comes home, but friction between them makes it a less than happy reunion.
Boober's fun side (his Sidebottom) wants to play!
Mokey decides that she wants to be a minstrel.
Cotterpin Doozer doesn't want to get her helmet and become a full-fledged Doozer worker. She wants to be a Fraggle!
Gobo and the gang trick the Gorgs into leaving the castle by impersonating the legendary Sir Hubris.
Sprocket becomes stuck in a hole so Gobel tries to help him out by taking butter from the Gorgs.
The Wizard, the shiftiest Fraggle in the Rock, has an ulterior motive in trading identities with Wembley.
Flange and Modem Doozer get involved in a building competition (something the Doozers haven't had for many years).
Red wants to be the leader, so she decides to start a club. When the idea takes off without her, Red finds herself with a club consisting of herself and Cotterpin Doozer.
Wembley can never make up his mind, until he gets Convincing John to help him.
When Gobo finds Doc's radio, the messages that come from it threaten to destroy the unity of the Fraggles.
Junior Gorg must work with the Fraggles after he is tricked into giving the Gorg castle to the conniving Wander McMooch.
While camping far from home, Mokey and Red discover a band of Fraggles who are humorless and cruel. After Mokey is captured, both sides get ready for war!
Gobo's writing of the Glory Song is interrupted when the Ditsies, the creatures whose bodies supply light to Fraggle Rock, start dying.
Boober accidentally creates a magical soup when he throws out old laundry water and a failed radish gumbo.
Red and Mokey decide to find a cave and live together.
Wembley and Gobo's friendship is strained when Wembley beats Gobo in a race.
Wrench Doozer meets strong peer pressure when the other Doozers in his team start ""flooping"".
Boober's relaxation is disturbed when his alter-ego Sidebottom shows up and puts some excitement in his day.

eps.t: The Invasion of the Toe Ticklers
eps.d: When Mokey brings a big furry caterpillar to the Rock to save her from the Gorgs, she has no idea what she's in for.
As Doc and Sprocket anticipate a traditional, human style Christmas, the Fraggles look forward to their own special holiday.

Red absolutely loves her radish bars (which are the equivalent of Pop-Tarts in our world). So when she sees that whenever she wakes up from sleeping that her bars are missing, she sets out to find the crook, which leads her to think her roommate Mokey stole them.

It's Joke Day in Fraggle Rock, and Boober's trying to get out before his friends find him and make him participate in the holiday he hates. But before he leaves, a huge purplish-pink glob rolls into the Great Hall. Boober ends up meeting Cotterpin Doozer as well, and the Doozers are on their way to start building near the Blob.

Gobo finds the legendary "Grapes of Generosity", mystical fruits which are rumored to compel anyone who eats them to share them with others. However, when Gobo brings them back, he ends up eating them and keeping them all to himself. Before long, Gobo becomes weightless, and tries to hide it from everyone else.

eps.t: Blanket of Snow, Blanket of Woe
eps.d: Mokey's been making too many promises lately; most notably, she was supposed to knit a tarpaulin for the Trash Heap before the next big snow. But she ends up being too late, and when she sees Philo and Gunge mourning over the frozen Marjorie, she decides she has to fix her mistake.

Gobo's come down with the Pebble Pox, so it's up to Boober and Wembley to go to the Cave of Shadows to get Gobo's cure. However, Boober's not too fond of the idea, and shares his worries with Wembley along the way. Before long, Wembley comes up with a bad case of the Pebble Pox, too.

eps.t: Home Is Where the Trash Is
eps.d: Philo and Gunge are sick and tired of being around Marjorie, so they decide to go off and find their home. The only problem is, they don't know where they originally came from. After a failed attempt to live in Mokey and Red's room, they travel far away, were caught and made slaves of Wander McMooch, the Trash Heap's biggest enemy.

Red and Wembley decide they're going on an adventure out in the Gorg's Garden today. At the same time, Ma is trying to get Pa and Junior to clean the basement, which is something that they really don't want to do. Junior catches a fluffy little creature named Skinfrith, and then Red and Wembley set him free so they can have some fun.

When Gobo, Red and Wembley are searching for unique items, Wembley comes upon an old green bottle. He takes it back to his cave, and while he's polishing the bottle up, a genie appears. Wembley can hardly believe his luck, but this genie has his own agenda. He destroys all the items Gobo and Red found, then he scares Boober half to death by making his laundry look like ghosts.

Mokey really, really wants to be a part of the Secret Society of Poohbahs, even though Red keeps telling her it's just a silly club. Then one day Mokey gets a letter saying that the Poohbah's would like to see her and find out if she's worthy of being a part of the club. She tells Red of her invitation, only to find out that she wasn't supposed to tell anyone about it.

eps.t: The Beanbarrow, the Burden, and the Bright Bouquet
eps.d: It's time for the annual Beanbarrow Race, and it's Gobo and Wembley vs. Red and Mokey. But when Mokey gets delayed, Red ends up having to do the race with Lanford, Mokey's annoying plant. As they're racing, Red and Lanford get lost at Table Rock Cavern which is where the Clinging Creepers live. When the Clinging Creepers start to attack them, Red and Lanford must work together in order to escape.

Gobo finds out about Uncle Matt's Secret Rules for Exploring through a postcard, and decides to open up a school for explorers. On his first expedition, he- along with Red, Wembley and Mokey- must travel to the Hole To Who-Knows-Where. Gobo becomes so fixated on the rules that he starts to disregard common sense, and of course, he and Red go at it again.
Boober takes it upon himself to test Wembley's baloobius - that is, the fringe on a Fraggles tail that stands up when a Fraggle is scared.
Junior Gorg's only friend is a huge radish named Geraldine, a fact which he discovers thanks to Mokey.

The Storyteller's having a story-telling session in Gobo's room, so Gobo decides that he wants to hear about Uncle Matt's first big journey. We see a flashback of little Matt- who's dressed like Gobo is now-with his Uncle Gobo, who thinks that his nephew Matt is annoying and clueless.

It's about to rain, and Ma wants Pa to fix the hole in the roof before it starts to pour. At the same time, Boober and Mokey are out getting radishes, and when Ma accidentally picks Boober up, he loses his hat. Boober's too afraid to go back out there, so Mokey goes out by herself to get the hat.

It's time for Rock Hockey, and Red's especially excited because her idol, Rock Hockey Hannah, is coming to watch her play. Her excitement's cut short, however, when she injures herself. She's still determined to play, and she escapes from her room to try it again, only to get even more hurt. But Red is becoming more and more stubborn; she doesn't want Hannah to think she's a wimp.
Pa Gorg decides to rid his and Ma's "Kissing Rock" of Fraggles once and for all with the Boredom Juice that Junior found, but things go horribly wrong.

When Cotterpin Doozer hears that Gobo is the bravest Fraggle in the Rock, she gets him to help her find the Cavern of Lost Dreams, which is where the original tower was built. When they get there, the remaining two Doozers, Yeaster and Crusty, don't want to come back. Will these two Doozers finally accept the changes that have occurred and move back to the Rock and help build once again?

Mokey and Red are putting on a puppet show and on their way to the production, Mokey hears the cries of a strange creature named Begoony, a magical fluffy critter who clings himself to Mokey and wants all of her attention. But when Mokey's torn between helping Begoony and putting on their show, Begoony puts a curse on her that makes her shrink, and then Begoony places her in a dollhouse.

Gobo feels as if he's done it all and wishes there was someplace he could explore. But when he hears that the Gorgs are going on a vacation, he thinks his problem is solved, and decides to map the inside of the Gorg's castle. So she gets Boober and Mokey to help scare Gobo, who's got Wembley by his side for the overnight stay.

When the Architect Doozer is teaching some younger Doozers about the great Doozer king (who looks a LOT like Gunge) Gunge wanders in the middle of the teaching session while looking for the M'Geecky vines for Marjorie. The Doozers think he's their long lost king, which makes Philo jealous, and he convinces the Doozers that the king isn't Gunge, it's Philo.
After Doc pulls up the floorboards in the workshop, Sprocket enters Fraggle Rock.

Wembley's got a special talent; he can hear water in the rock walls. But when Gobo and Red don't believe him, he sets out to prove he's right. When water finally breaks out, the Fraggles discover that this type of water is special. But when the water starts to cause rock quakes and Gobo falls into the cracks, is it finally time to shut down the fun?
Boober worries that he bores his friends, leading to the return of his alter ego, Sidebottom. Doc, meanwhile, pretends to be an old sailor.
Uncle Matt returns home from Outer Space, and disgraces himself in front of Gobo and his friends. But all that changes when he makes an incredible discovery.

It is the night of the blue moon and Junior Gorg is summoned by a mysterious figure to play the Royal Kazoo. If he succeeds, Junior will prove himself to be truly royal. But if he fails, he will be banished for a hundred years.
Wembley loves the annual Duetathon — a contest in which Fraggles sing duets. But the entire Rock is dumbfounded to learn who Wembley chooses as his singing partner.
Boober believes his life is complete when he is given a rare and legendary gift. But he soon finds out gifts are meant to be shared.
When a new artist shows up in Fraggle Rock, Mokey is determined to prove that she is better. She even goes as far as to acquire a magic paintbrush — one that brings danger to anyone who uses it.

Wembley, feeling unhappy because he never gets to show off in front of his friends, meets a magical creature that gives him the power to fly. But his friends refuse to believe he has this magical gift and restrain him from flying. Other Fraggles believe him but want to exploit his gift. Wembley finally learns to fly for the right reasons.
Red Fraggle tries to follow Uncle Travelling Matt into Outer Space and finds a world that's exactly like her imaginary one — complete with a fire-breathing blue dragon.
Mokey plans a solo getaway to Wonder Mountain and Red secretly follows her getting in all kinds of trouble. Meanwhile, Sprocket is off on his own adventure causing Doc to worry.
Uncle Matt has gotten Gobo a frog from Outer Space for his birthday, but when it gets loose while Wembley is supposed to be hiding it, things get really crazy!

After being hit on the head by an exploding radish, Boober gets amnesia and thinks he's a Gorg. When he tells Ma and Pa Gorg, they believe him, because they think a sorceror has changed Junior, who is missing, into a Fraggle.
It's Red's 28th birthday in a row since the Festival of the Bells when she finds a magic mirror (named Mavis) that leads her to a very special birthday party.

In setting out to solve the riddle of Rhyming Rock, Gobo learns from the Storyteller about a book of magic spells his Uncle Matt discovered. The book includes a spell for solving riddles. But he doesn't hear the whole story and when he uses the spell everything goes wrong and Gobo has to find a way to right the damage he has done.
Gobo doesn't believe he has an "inner voice" so he doesn't heed the warning that he, Sprocket and Wrench Doozer might be in danger.
Cotterpin Doozer is accused of consorting with Fraggles, and she must prove that Fraggles are noble and intelligent and worthy of the respect of the Doozers.
When Fraggle Rock's water supply is contaminated by the Silly Creatures, only Boober can save the day.

Red and Gobo's swimming competition is interrupted by the annual arrival of the Knobblies, pink vine-like plants which are particularly thick this year, and which turn out to lead to something quite unexpected.
On his first solo overnight hike, Wembley meets Mudwell the Mudbunny, whose behavior first entertains, and then confuses him.
Mokey, Wembley and Boober get transported back in time, to an era when Fraggles are bald, have leaders, and never laugh.
It's Ma and Pa Gorg's 513th anniversary, and they must get married again. But where's the ring?
The Fraggle Horn is missing, and Red tries to find it, accusing many along the way.

eps.t: The Gorg Who Would Be King
eps.d: The leaves of the Nirvana tree have fallen, and it's time for Junior Gorg to become king, but not until he has a chance to get a different perspective on the Universe.
Cantus and the Minstrels are back and ready to perform the Song of Songs, but first Gobo must find the Honk of Honks. Along the way, he meets Doc face to face for the first time.
Doc finally knows of the Fraggles, when he and Sprocket have to move. Will Gobo be able to relay the Trash Heap's message ""You cannot leave the magic"" in time?
